title: Garden Maintenance
description: Every garden has its own story, its own rhythm. We don't just maintain plants—we thoughtfully honor the life and beauty you've cultivated

services.name: Lawn Mowing & Edging
services.description: Keep your lawn clean and well-defined with precise mowing and crisp edging. We maintain the ideal grass height for healthy growth while giving your outdoor space a neat, polished look.

services.name: Pruning & Trimming
services.description: Expert pruning and trimming to shape your trees, shrubs, and hedges. This not only enhances visual aesthetics but also promotes structural health and prevents overgrowth.

services.name: Weed Control
services.description: Effective weed management and surface control. We eliminate invasive plants from borders and lawn spaces to ensure your primary landscape gets nutrients properly.

services.name: Regular Upkeep Visits
services.description: Scheduled maintenance programs to keep your gardens looking pristine year-round. Includes general cleaning, seasonal touch-ups, and structural health checks.

title: Outdoor Upgrades
description: Outdoor Upgrades refresh your space with thoughtful improvements that add beauty, function, and a renewed sense of comfort every time you step outside.

services.name: Mulching
services.description: Enhance your garden with professional mulching that retains moisture, regulates soil temperature, and suppresses weeds, keeping your plants healthy and your outdoor space clean and well-finished.

services.name: New planting
services.description: Refresh your garden with new planting that brings color, structure, and life to your outdoor space. We select and position plants based on soil, sunlight, and seasonal conditions to ensure healthy growth and long-lasting beauty.

services.name: Landscape refresh
services.description: Refresh your outdoor space with a landscape update that improves structure, balance, and appearance. We enhance elements, adjust plant layouts, and restore areas to bring new life and a clean, cohesive look to your garden.

services.name: Irrigation support / drainage fixes
services.description: Improve garden with irrigation and drainage fixes that ensure water flow and prevent buildup. We adjust systems, clear blockages, and optimize drainage to keep your landscape healthy and protected year-round.

title: Plant & Soil Health
description: Plant & Soil Health care strengthens your garden from the ground up, restoring soil quality and helping plants grow stronger and vibrant over time.

services.name: Fertilization
services.description: Enhance your garden with professional fertilization that nourishes the soil, strengthens root systems, and promotes lush, healthy plant growth for a greener, more vibrant outdoor space.

services.name: Pest and disease treatment
services.description: Protect your garden with professional pest and disease treatment that targets harmful insects and infections early, helping your plants stay healthy, strong, and beautifully thriving all season.

services.name: Soil improvement
services.description: Enhance your garden with professional soil improvement that enriches soil quality, boosts nutrient levels, and creates the perfect foundation for stronger, healthier plant growth and a more vibrant outdoor space.

services.name: Seasonal planting care
services.description: Seasonal planting care keeps your garden fresh and vibrant year-round. We select and replace plants by season to ensure a healthy, well-maintained outdoor space in every weather condition.

title: Seasonal Services
description: Seasonal Services keep your garden healthy, clean, and visually appealing year-round with timely cleanups, planting, and weather preparation.

services.name: Spring cleanup
services.description: Give your outdoor space a fresh seasonal reset with professional spring cleanup that removes winter debris, clears dead growth, and prepares your landscape for healthy new growth and a clean, vibrant look.

services.name: Monsoon / storm prep
services.description: Protect your outdoor space with professional monsoon and storm preparation that strengthens plants, clears drainage, and secures vulnerable areas to reduce damage and keep your landscape safe during heavy weather.

services.name: Leaf cleanup
services.description: Keep your outdoor space clean, fresh, and refreshed with professional leaf cleanup that removes fallen leaves, clears debris, and restores a neat, healthy, and well-maintained landscape.

services.name: Holiday / event garden prep
services.description: Give your outdoor space a festive, polished look with professional holiday and event garden preparation that includes cleaning, styling, and arranging plants to create a welcoming and beautifully presented setting for any occasion.
